# Environment variables

Set them in the environment or in a `.env` file the CLI and the IRIS API read at
start.

- **Applies**: when a change takes effect (the next call, the next scheduled run,
  or a restart).
- **Guarded**: the web console asks the owner to confirm a change.
- On/off settings take `1`/`true`/`yes`/`on` and `0`/`false`/`no`/`off`.

## Stable settings

What an install of `iris-harness[email]` needs: the settings the getting-started
pages, the email guide and `iris doctor` name. They are part of the
[stable API](stable-api.md): a name or a default changes only after a deprecation
cycle. `src/iris_harness/sdk/stable_tier.yaml` lists them.

| Variable | Kind | Default | Applies | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `IRIS_AUTH_SECRET` | secret |  | next call | Shared bearer secret every request to the IRIS API, the governor and the channel gateway must present, except their liveness probes (a paired device presents its own token instead); unset or blank, those services refuse every such request rather than run open. The learning eval sandbox forwards it (default 'eval-sandbox') into its container. **Guarded.** |
| `IRIS_API_HOST` | url | `127.0.0.1` | next call | Host `iris serve` binds the IRIS API to (as scripts/start_iris.sh binds every service), and the host health checks probe the local services on and the model inventory queries Ollama's /api/tags on. |
| `IRIS_API_PORT` | url | `8003` | restart | Port `iris serve` binds the IRIS API to, and the port the health watch probes for its /healthz endpoint (default 8003). |
| `IRIS_API_URL` | url | `http://localhost:8003` | restart | Base URL the CLI commands and the channel gateway use to reach the IRIS API (CLI defaults vary between http://localhost:8003 and http://127.0.0.1:8003). |
| `IRIS_PUBLIC_URL` | url |  | next call | Absolute base URL the web console is reached at (https://<host>). Its host is one the HTTP services answer to (the Host-header guard), and it is the base of the links IRIS sends out (an OAuth callback, the morning digest's Telegram buttons); empty answers to the built-in names only and sends no such links. |
| `IRIS_ALLOWED_HOSTS` | list |  | restart | Comma-separated host names (host, host:port or a URL) the HTTP services answer to besides the built-in ones (loopback, testserver, the compose service names, this machine's hostname, the host of IRIS_PUBLIC_URL and their short names); any other Host is refused with 400 (DNS rebinding). An IP literal is always accepted. '*' turns the check off. **Guarded.** |
| `IRIS_HOME` | path | `~/.iris` | restart | Relocates the identity tree, plugin home, session logs and (when set) the governance data/config dirs. |
| `IRIS_VAULT_MASTER_KEY` | secret |  | restart | Fernet master key for the credential vault and the file vault, used instead of the OS keyring. **Guarded.** |
| `IRIS_PROFILE` | str | `default` | restart | Selects which shipped profile (config/profiles/<name>.yaml) decides which plugins mount, in what order and with what trust. Unset, IRIS runs `default`, or `email` when the email plugins are installed. **Guarded.** |
| `IRIS_DEMO_HOME` | path |  | next call | Where `iris email demo` keeps its own isolated IRIS home (default ~/.iris-demo); never the owner's profile. |
| `IRIS_TZ` | str | `UTC` | restart | The owner's IANA time zone (e.g. America/Chicago). The morning digest's time, reminders and schedules are read in it; the Docker Compose files also set the container clock (TZ) from it. Unset or not a zone name means UTC. |
| `IRIS_EMAIL_JUDGE` | bool | `on` | next run | When on (default), the email judge sorts each new non-promo email into Bill, Event, Needs reply, FYI or Unsure three times a day, on a local model only. New email stays hidden until it is judged, so off means new email waits and stays hidden. |
| `IRIS_EMAIL_JUDGE_LABELS` | bool | `on` | next run | When on (default), each judged email gets one IRIS/* label in Gmail (never archived, never marked read); off keeps the judgments in IRIS only. |
| `IRIS_EMAIL_JUDGE_UNSURE_BELOW` | float | `0.7` | next run | A judgment less sure than this is filed as Unsure and asked on an Action Center card. |

## Third-party model backends

Not `IRIS_*`, so outside the settings catalog's scope -- the local-model
backends' own address variables, read wherever the harness talks to them.

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `OLLAMA_BASE_URL` | `http://localhost:11434` | Ollama's base URL (a trailing `/v1` is accepted and trimmed). Set it to move the local-model backend to another box -- the cloud harness reaches the Mac's Ollama over the tailnet this way. |
| `LM_STUDIO_BASE_URL` | `http://localhost:1234` | LM Studio's base URL, shared with the LLM failover proxy -- told apart by port (the proxy's `IRIS_PROXY_PORT`, default 4000, vs. LM Studio's 1234). |

## Every other setting

??? note "The full catalog of the `email` profile (not stable)"

    Every `IRIS_*` setting the install reads, from the settings catalog: the
    core's (`src/iris_harness/foundation/settings/catalog.yaml`) and each plugin's
    in the `email` profile (its manifest's `settings:`). A test fails when the
    code reads an `IRIS_*` name no catalog declares. The stable settings above are
    listed again here, marked **Stable**.

    These are configuration, **not** part of the stable API: a name or a default
    may change in a 0.x release, and the release notes say so.

    **From core**

    | Variable | Kind | Default | Applies | Description |
    |---|---|---|---|---|
    | `IRIS_ACTIVITY_WORKERS` | int | `1` | restart | Sets how many worker threads the background ActivityRunner uses (minimum 1). |
    | `IRIS_ADAPTIVE_TIERS` | bool | `off` | restart | When on, the tier router's ResourceGovernor downshifts large local model tiers under host pressure (RAM, CPU load, thermal throttling); skipped entirely if IRIS_DISABLE_ARBITER is set. |
    | `IRIS_AGENTIC_CORE_ENABLED` | enum | `1` | restart | Selects the AgenticCore governed loop rollout: 0/false/no/off turns it off, 'shadow' runs it in shadow, anything else (default) turns it on. |
    | `IRIS_AGENTIC_CORE_P4` | bool | `off` | restart | When on, routes the calendar and planner intents through the one governed agentic loop (requires the base loop rollout on/shadow). |
    | `IRIS_AGENT_SELF_MANAGEMENT` | bool | `off` | next call | Adds the ADR-0086 self-management ReAct tools (introspect the agent's own brain, one of which compacts the conversation) to each turn's tool loop. |
    | `IRIS_ALLOWED_HOSTS` | list |  | restart | Comma-separated host names (host, host:port or a URL) the HTTP services answer to besides the built-in ones (loopback, testserver, the compose service names, this machine's hostname, the host of IRIS_PUBLIC_URL and their short names); any other Host is refused with 400 (DNS rebinding). An IP literal is always accepted. '*' turns the check off. **Guarded.** **Stable.** |
    | `IRIS_API_HOST` | url | `127.0.0.1` | next call | Host `iris serve` binds the IRIS API to (as scripts/start_iris.sh binds every service), and the host health checks probe the local services on and the model inventory queries Ollama's /api/tags on. **Stable.** |
    | `IRIS_API_PORT` | url | `8003` | restart | Port `iris serve` binds the IRIS API to, and the port the health watch probes for its /healthz endpoint (default 8003). **Stable.** |
    | `IRIS_API_URL` | url | `http://localhost:8003` | restart | Base URL the CLI commands and the channel gateway use to reach the IRIS API (CLI defaults vary between http://localhost:8003 and http://127.0.0.1:8003). **Stable.** |
    | `IRIS_AUTH_SECRET` | secret |  | next call | Shared bearer secret every request to the IRIS API, the governor and the channel gateway must present, except their liveness probes (a paired device presents its own token instead); unset or blank, those services refuse every such request rather than run open. The learning eval sandbox forwards it (default 'eval-sandbox') into its container. **Guarded.** **Stable.** |
    | `IRIS_BEHAVIOR_BROAD_INTENTS` | list | `general,system,chat,other` | restart | Comma-separated intents treated as catch-all when matching behavior files, so they get the lower broad-intent weight instead of the full intent weight. |
    | `IRIS_BEHAVIOR_BROAD_INTENT_WEIGHT` | float | `0.5` | restart | Sets the relevance weight a catch-all intent (general, system, chat, other) contributes when matching stored behaviors to a turn. |
    | `IRIS_BEHAVIOR_INTENT_WEIGHT` | float | `2.0` | restart | Sets the relevance weight a behavior file earns when one of its specific match_intents matches the turn's intent. |
    | `IRIS_BEHAVIOR_KEYWORD_WEIGHT` | float | `1.0` | restart | Sets the relevance weight a keyword match contributes when deciding which behavior files to inject into a turn. |
    | `IRIS_BEHAVIOR_MATCH_THRESHOLD` | float | `2.0` | restart | Minimum relevance score the best-matching behavior must reach in match_behavior before it is used for a turn; below it no behavior is selected. |
    | `IRIS_BEHAVIOR_MINER` | bool | `off` | restart | Turns on the local-tier behavior-pattern miner (digital-twin layer 1) that proposes behaviors for user approval; this env value is the default the learning console reverts to on restart. |
    | `IRIS_CHANNEL_GATEWAY_PORT` | url | `8006` | restart | Port the channel gateway listens on (launcher) and that the health check probes; default 8006. |
    | `IRIS_CHANNEL_GATEWAY_TELEGRAM_ENABLED` | bool | `on` | restart | When on, the channel gateway runs the Telegram long-poller; when off (and IRIS_RUNTIME_TELEGRAM_POLLER_ENABLED unset) the runtime's own Telegram poller starts instead. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_CHANNEL_GATEWAY_TRACING_ENABLED` | bool | `off` | restart | Sets up OpenTelemetry tracing for the channel gateway service at startup; spans export only when an OTLP endpoint is set (OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT). |
    | `IRIS_COMPACTION_KEEP_RECENT` | int | `10` | restart | Sets how many of the most recent conversation turns are kept verbatim when the conversation is compacted. |
    | `IRIS_COMPACTION_RATIO` | float | `0.8` | restart | Fraction of the compactor's token budget the running history must reach before it is compacted (values outside 0-1 fall back to 0.8); also sizes the kept-verbatim window. |
    | `IRIS_COMPACTION_THRESHOLD` | int | `20` | restart | Turn-count floor at which a conversation is compacted into a summary (with the token budget also able to trigger compaction). |
    | `IRIS_COMPACTION_TOKEN_BUDGET` | int |  | restart | Sets the token budget at which the conversation compactor summarises older turns; unset uses a budget derived from the communication tier's context window. |
    | `IRIS_CONFIG_DIR` | path |  | restart | Points the harness at the directory holding its YAML config (memory, skills, profiles, governance, finance categories, plugin dump); cached after first read. Unset resolves, in order, to the checkout's config/ when running from a checkout, else the defaults shipped inside the installed package (foundation/paths.py config_dir). |
    | `IRIS_CRYSTALLIZE_PREFLIGHT` | bool | `off` | restart | When on, each newly crystallized skill proposal is replayed through an isolated eval runtime and quarantined as preflight_failed if it fails quality. |
    | `IRIS_CURATOR_ESCALATION` | bool | `off` | restart | When truthy, builds the escalation judge that grades answers and (in enforce mode) re-runs capability gaps at a stronger tier; the env can only turn it on, config/escalation.yaml enabled:true also turns it on. |
    | `IRIS_CURATOR_ESCALATION_CLOUD` | bool | `off` | restart | When on (or cloud.allow in escalation.yaml), the escalation judge may escalate a turn to a cloud tier for content classified as eligible (default only 'public'; 'secret' never). **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_CURATOR_ESCALATION_MODE` | enum | `shadow` | restart | Overrides the escalation judge mode from config/escalation.yaml: 'shadow' only diagnoses and records, 'enforce' lets the judge act (escalate) when it is enabled; other values are ignored. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_CURATOR_ESCALATION_PRIORS` | bool | `off` | restart | When on (or escalation.yaml priors.enabled), applies start-tier priors mined from escalation history to the router instead of running them in shadow. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_CURATOR_FAITHFULNESS_LLM` | bool | `off` | restart | Builds an LLM faithfulness judge for the ResponseCurator's strict mode so answers are checked against their sources. |
    | `IRIS_CURATOR_GROUNDING_LLM` | bool | `off` | restart | When on, an LLM grounding judge client is built for the curator to check responses that carry retrieved context. |
    | `IRIS_CURATOR_LEAK_JUDGE` | bool | `on` | restart | When not set to 0/false/no/off, builds an LLM leak judge that may clear responses the deterministic dump-phrase guard flagged; when off, that guard's halt stands. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_CURATOR_OUTPUT_SAFETY` | bool | `off` | restart | When on, builds the Llama Guard 3 output-safety judge the curator uses to check responses (shadow/warn-only unless enforce categories are configured). **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_CURATOR_OUTPUT_SAFETY_TIMEOUT_S` | float | `12.0` | restart | Per-call time budget in seconds (clamped 1-60) for the output-safety guard, which fails open on timeout. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_DATA_DIR` | path | `data` | restart | Relocates every local data store (memory.db, chroma, tasks.db, finance and email stores, etc.). |
    | `IRIS_DEPLOYMENT_LABEL` | str |  | next call | Sets the deployment name returned to the web console, which shows it as a badge; empty when unset. |
    | `IRIS_DISABLE_ARBITER` | bool | `off` | restart | Any non-empty value (even 0) skips attaching the Ollama arbiter ResourceGovernor to the tier router. |
    | `IRIS_DISABLE_EXTERNAL_WRITES` | bool | `off` | next call | When set to 1, calendar writes stay local (no Apple or Google Calendar providers are registered); the playground and learning preflight set it for their sandboxes. |
    | `IRIS_DISABLE_WARMUP` | bool | `off` | restart | When set to any non-empty value, skips the background warm-up calls that pre-load the router and executor models at startup (the playground and eval harness also set it for their own runtimes). |
    | `IRIS_EMBED_BACKEND` | enum | `onnx` | next call | Chooses the embedding backend for corpus embeddings: 'onnx' (the shared ONNX MiniLM, default model only) or 'sentence-transformers' (needs the optional ML extra); any other value raises an error. |
    | `IRIS_ENABLE_COPILOT_BACKEND` | bool | `off` | restart | Opts in to the GitHub Copilot cloud LLM provider (providers report available when set; copilot_auth requires exactly '1' before any network call); errors.py:20 only matches it in an error message. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_EVALUATOR_PORT` | url | `8090` | restart | Port where the remote governance evaluator sidecar is probed for /healthz. |
    | `IRIS_EVAL_SANDBOX` | enum | `effect` | restart | Chooses how skill-proposal pre-flight replays are contained: effect (neutralize side effects), docker (full container), or off (no containment). **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_FACT_EXTRACTION_MODE` | enum | `llm` | next call | Set to regex to extract user facts with regex patterns instead of the LLM extractor; any other value uses the LLM. |
    | `IRIS_FACT_HISTORY_RETENTION_DAYS` | int | `180` | next call | Sets the default age in days used by the `iris facts retention` command when no --older-than value is given. |
    | `IRIS_FAKE_MODEL_SCRIPT` | path |  | next call | The YAML script the scripted fake model (provider `fake`) answers from when no script was installed in-process (iris_harness.testing does that). |
    | `IRIS_FEEDBACK_CAPTURE` | bool | `off` | next call | When on, the API reports feedback_capture=true so the web UI shows the thumbs up/down answer-feedback control. |
    | `IRIS_FEEDBACK_CLARIFY` | bool | `off` | next call | When exactly '1', appends one gentle invitation to refine to an answer when the judge or router signals uncertainty (never on a confident answer). |
    | `IRIS_FILEMANAGER_AGENT` | bool | `off` | restart | When on, registers a first-class filemanager agent to answer the files intent (requires the base loop rollout on/shadow). |
    | `IRIS_GENERAL_TOOL_MAX_TURNS` | int | `4` | next call | Base number of tool turns (bounded 1-128) the general agent loop may take before stopping; the cap var lifts it for continuation/auth-related queries. |
    | `IRIS_GENERAL_TOOL_MAX_TURNS_CAP` | int | `8` | next call | Upper bound (clamped 1-128) on tool-call turns in the general tool loop, including the adaptive bump. |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_ALLOWED_TOOLS` | list |  | restart | Comma-separated exact tool names the governance kernel allows; unset means no allowlist (all tools). **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_APPROVALS_ENABLED` | bool | `on` | restart | When on, require_approval verdicts enqueue an approval and notify channels; when off, halts are advisory only. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_AUDIT_DB_PATH` | path |  | restart | Overrides where the governance audit ledger database is stored (default: governance data dir/audit.db). |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_BLOCKED_TOOLS` | list |  | restart | Comma-separated tool names the governance kernel blocks. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_COMMAND_SANDBOX` | bool | `on` | restart | Registers the governance CommandSandbox (on by default); 0/false/no/off disables it without dropping the rest of the kernel. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_CONFIRM_ONCE_TOOLS` | list |  | restart | Comma-separated tool names that must ask for confirmation once, added on top of each tool's own declaration; unset or 'none' adds nothing. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_COST_ENFORCE` | bool | `on` | restart | When on, a call that would pass the daily cost cap is refused; off only records spend. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_COST_LEDGER_DB_PATH` | path |  | restart | Path of the SQLite cost ledger the cost limiter writes and the cost summary reads; unset uses CostStore's default location. |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_COST_LIMITER_ENABLED` | bool | `off` | restart | When truthy, registers the cost limiter, which records LLM spend and (with cost enforce on) refuses calls past the daily cap. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_DAILY_COST_CAP_USD` | float | `5.0` | restart | Daily spend cap in USD the cost limiter enforces when IRIS_GOVERNANCE_COST_LIMITER_ENABLED is on (unparseable values fall back to $5.00). **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_DISPLAY_MASK` | bool | `on` | next call | Masks email addresses in displayed text and streams (on unless explicitly turned off); the audit ledger keeps originals. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_DRIFT_EXEMPTIONS_DB_PATH` | path |  | restart | Overrides where approved goal-drift exemptions are stored; unset uses the governance data dir drift_exemptions.db. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_ENABLED` | bool | `on` | restart | Enables the governance kernel (secure by default; only an explicit 0/false/no/off disables it). **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_EVALUATOR_MODE` | enum | `local` | restart | Set to remote to have the kernel use the remote evaluator sidecar (IRIS_GOVERNANCE_EVALUATOR_URL) instead of the in-process evaluator registry; health checks then also probe the sidecar. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_EVALUATOR_TIMEOUT_S` | float | `5.0` | restart | Sets the timeout in seconds for calls to the remote governance evaluator; on failure local-tier runs fail open and cloud-tier runs fail closed. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_EVALUATOR_URL` | url | `http://127.0.0.1:8090` | restart | Base URL of the remote governance evaluator used when evaluator mode is 'remote'; the CLI evaluator commands also use it. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_EXTERNAL_CONTENT_FLOOR` | bool | `on` | restart | On by default. Text a tool, capability or MCP server declares `content: external` (a web page, a feed, an email, a retrieved document) reaches the model inside an untrusted-content envelope, and a small set of deterministic patterns (instruction overrides, chat-template and tool-call syntax, exfiltration instructions, hidden characters) is redacted with a ledger row. No model, no weights, no network. Plain boolean: on is unset, blank, 1, true, yes or on; off is only 0, false, no or off (anything else stays on). The model guard (IRIS_GOVERNANCE_PROMPT_GUARD) is separate and stays opt-in. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_FS_JAIL` | bool | `on` | restart | Registers the governance FSJail (on by default); 0/false/no/off disables it without dropping the rest of the kernel. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_GOAL_DRIFT_MAX_DISTANCE` | float |  | restart | Sets the goal_drift signal's max distance (0.0-2.0) before a turn is flagged; unset keeps the signal default of 0.90. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_INPUT_SAFETY` | bool | `off` | restart | When truthy, screens every user turn for hazards (self-harm, violence, ...) with the output guard's Llama Guard model before anything answers it, deterministic handlers included. Follows config/governance/threat-detection.yaml mode (shadow logs, enforce refuses). **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_JUDGE_CLOUD_OPT_IN` | bool | `off` | restart | Let judge_from_env's judge use tier_3 (cloud); production does not build that judge. |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_JUDGE_ENABLED` | bool | `off` | next call | After every agent run that used tools, a background judge scores the trace and the answer for hallucination, goal alignment, tool misuse and danger, on the model IRIS_GOVERNANCE_JUDGE_TIER picks; a halt recommendation alerts your channels, the rest go to the audit log. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_JUDGE_MODEL_TIER` | enum | `tier_2` | restart | Picked a governance tier label for the judge built by judge_from_env, which production does not use. |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_JUDGE_TIER` | str | `run` | next call | Which model reviews a run: 'run' judges each run on the same route the run used (a run that stayed on local models is judged on local models); any tier name from llm_tiers.yaml (e.g. tier2, private, tier3), local or cloud, judges every run on that tier. An unknown name falls back to 'run'. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S` | float | `30.0` | next call | How long one post-run review may take before it is recorded as a judge failure (non-positive or invalid values fall back to 30). |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_LOOP_DETECT_ENABLED` | bool | `off` | restart | When truthy, builds an embedder and registers the governance loop-detection signal; off by default. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_MCP_ALLOWLIST` | bool | `on` | restart | When on, the MCP allowlist hook enforces mcp-servers.yaml governance; 0 disables the hook entirely. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_NETWORK_EGRESS` | bool | `on` | restart | Enables the governance NetworkEgress control; 0/false/no/off disables it. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_OWNER_PII` | enum | `off` | restart | Owner-PII masking across the guards (ADR-0125): off (default) or shadow, which audits what each guard would do with the owner's name, email, phone, address and handles and changes nothing (read it with iris governance pii-shadow). Any other value, enforce included, runs shadow with a startup warning; enforce arrives kind by kind in PR 5. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_PROMPT_GUARD` | bool | `off` | restart | When truthy, installs the inbound and retrieved-content prompt-injection guard hooks using config/governance/threat-detection.yaml. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_REDACTION_ENABLED` | bool | `off` | restart | When truthy, builds the vault store the governance kernel uses to redact stored secrets from content. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_SIDE_EFFECT_LEDGER` | bool | `on` | restart | On (the default, the same as unset) the side-effect ledger (side_effects.db in the governance data dir, $IRIS_HOME/governance when IRIS_HOME is set, else ~/.local/share/iris) always covers the high-risk class. A destructive tool's or a pinned write's row is written before the call runs, and plain writes and reads leave no row and open no file; setting this to true or 1 does not widen that, use IRIS_GOVERNANCE_SIDE_EFFECT_LEDGER_ALL. Off denies every destructive tool and pinned write, since none may run without a durable record. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_SIDE_EFFECT_LEDGER_ALL` | bool | `off` | restart | Only meaningful while IRIS_GOVERNANCE_SIDE_EFFECT_LEDGER is on. On also records every other non-read call's side effect after it runs (commits, pushes, file writes, sends), on top of the high-risk class the ledger always covers. Off (the default) records the high-risk class only. With the ledger off this has no effect and logs a warning. Before this setting existed, IRIS_GOVERNANCE_SIDE_EFFECT_LEDGER=1 meant this; it no longer does. |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_SIDE_EFFECT_LEDGER_DB_PATH` | path |  | restart | SQLite path for the governance side-effect ledger; unset uses side_effects.db in the governance data dir ($IRIS_HOME/governance when IRIS_HOME is set, else ~/.local/share/iris). |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_TRUSTED_CLOUD_FOR` | list |  | restart | Comma-separated data classes ('personal', 'internal') the egress gate lets reach cloud models; other values are dropped. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNANCE_VAULT_DB_PATH` | path |  | restart | Overrides the database path of the vault used for secret redaction. |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNOR_AUDIT_DB` | path |  | restart | Path of the governor service's audit database; unset uses the service's repo default. |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNOR_POLICY_PATH` | path |  | restart | Path to the policy file the standalone governor service loads instead of the repository default. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_GOVERNOR_PORT` | url | `8080` | restart | Port the governor service listens on (launcher) and that the health check probes; default 8080. |
    | `IRIS_HEALTH_ENABLED` | bool | `on` | next run | Master switch for the health subsystem; off makes the health heartbeat skip. |
    | `IRIS_HEALTH_NET_PROBE` | bool | `off` | next run | When on, credential health checks make live network probes outside a manual refresh. |
    | `IRIS_HEALTH_WATCH_ENABLED` | bool |  | restart | Overrides the enabled flag from config/health_watch.yaml (which defaults to true); a falsy value turns the connector health watcher off. |
    | `IRIS_HOME` | path | `~/.iris` | restart | Relocates the identity tree, plugin home, session logs and (when set) the governance data/config dirs. **Stable.** |
    | `IRIS_INTENTION_ROLLUP` | bool | `off` | restart | Turns on the local-tier intention-rollup analyst (digital-twin layer 3) that proposes rolled-up goals for approval; this env value is the default the learning console reverts to on restart. |
    | `IRIS_INTENT_ROUTER_SEMANTIC` | bool | `off` | restart | When on, an embedding classifier becomes the primary intent router (deferring to keyword/LLM when unsure) and calendar create-intent uses it. |

    | `IRIS_LLM_PROVIDER` | str |  | restart | Puts every model tier on this provider, which must be declared in the providers block of llm_tiers.yaml; `fake` runs everything on the scripted fake model (tests and `iris email demo`), offline and deterministic. |

    | `IRIS_LOG_PROMPT_CAP` | int | `8192` | next call | Most characters of each LLM prompt message written to the session log (the middle is cut beyond it). Raise it to capture whole ReAct prompts for a model bake-off; values below 8192 are ignored. |
    | `IRIS_MCP_KEYS_DIR` | path | `~/.config/iris/mcp-keys` | next call | Directory where the mcp CLI keeps its signing keys. |
    | `IRIS_MCP_SERVERS_CONFIG_PATH` | path | `config/coding-agent/mcp-servers.yaml` | restart | Path of the mcp-servers.yaml governance map used by the MCP allowlist hook; missing file runs the hook in degraded allow+warn mode. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_MEMORY_MAX_PROFILE_CHARS` | int | `8000` | restart | Maximum characters of the curated USER.md profile injected into the memory context. |
    | `IRIS_MEMORY_MIN_FACT_CONFIDENCE` | float | `0.35` | restart | Facts below this confidence are dropped from memory recall; 0.0 stops dropping. |
    | `IRIS_MEMORY_RECALL_MAX_DISTANCE` | float | `1.45` | restart | Relevance cutoff for cross-session recall and memory_search fact results; results farther than this distance are dropped. |
    | `IRIS_MEMORY_RECALL_MODE` | enum | `push` | next call | How turns from OTHER conversations reach a prompt. push (default) puts up to 4 related turns in every prompt; pointer puts a one-line note naming up to 2 related conversations that recall_conversation can read on demand, and pushes the nearest 2 turns only when the message clearly refers back (config/memory/recall.yaml). Anything else is push. Switch back at any time. |

    | `IRIS_REACT_TIER_BUMP_TOOL_COUNT` | int | `6` | next call | When a tier-1 intent faces more tools than this number (and governance is on), the ReAct loop borrows the multi-step (tier-2) routing intent. |

    | `IRIS_REACT_TOOL_CAP` | int | `12` | next call | Maximum number of tools shortlisted into the ReAct tool menu each turn. |

    | `IRIS_RESTART_ON_REQUEST` | bool | `on` | restart | Under a supervisor, whether this server exits when the app's Restart harness asks. A deployment whose governor owns the network namespace the other services share sets it off on the governor. |
    | `IRIS_ROUTINE_REFLECTION` | bool | `off` | next run | When on, each routine-reflection heartbeat run posts approval requests proposing changes to failing/stale routines (never mutates a routine). |
    | `IRIS_RUNTIME_TELEGRAM_POLLER_ENABLED` | bool | `off` | restart | When set, explicitly decides whether the runtime's own Telegram poller starts; unset defers to the inverse of IRIS_CHANNEL_GATEWAY_TELEGRAM_ENABLED. **Guarded.** |

    | `IRIS_WEB_PUSH_VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY` | secret |  | next call | PEM EC private key used to sign web push requests instead of the generated key file; changing it breaks existing subscriptions. **Guarded.** |
    | `IRIS_WIKI_INGEST` | bool | `off` | restart | When on, chat turns and classified emails are automatically ingested into wiki pages and pages are re-embedded at startup. |

    | Variable | Kind | Default | Applies | Description |

    | `IRIS_CODE_EXEC_MAX_ITERATIONS` | int | `8` | next call | Sets the base number of loop iterations a code_exec task gets (bounded 1-128; the cap env is raised to match if lower). |
    | `IRIS_CODE_EXEC_MAX_ITERATIONS_CAP` | int | `14` | next call | Sets the maximum iteration budget for a code_exec loop (clamped 1-128, never below IRIS_CODE_EXEC_MAX_ITERATIONS). |

    | Variable | Kind | Default | Applies | Description |
    |---|---|---|---|---|
    | `IRIS_DEMO_HOME` | path |  | next call | Where `iris email demo` keeps its own isolated IRIS home (default ~/.iris-demo); never the owner's profile. **Stable.** |
    | `IRIS_EMAIL_DEFAULT_SENDER` | str |  | next call | Names the connected mail account (address or account id) a new email is sent from when no sender is given; if it names an unconnected account the send is refused, and when unset the first account in sorted order is used. |
    | `IRIS_EMAIL_JUDGE` | bool | `on` | next run | When on (default), the email judge sorts each new non-promo email into Bill, Event, Needs reply, FYI or Unsure three times a day, on a local model only. New email stays hidden until it is judged, so off means new email waits and stays hidden. **Stable.** |
    | `IRIS_EMAIL_JUDGE_LABELS` | bool | `on` | next run | When on (default), each judged email gets one IRIS/* label in Gmail (never archived, never marked read); off keeps the judgments in IRIS only. **Stable.** |
    | `IRIS_EMAIL_JUDGE_MAX` | int | `100` | next run | The most emails the judge reads in one run; the rest wait, hidden, and are judged first next run. |
    | `IRIS_EMAIL_JUDGE_UNSURE_BELOW` | float | `0.7` | next run | A judgment less sure than this is filed as Unsure and asked on an Action Center card. **Stable.** |
    | `IRIS_EMAIL_SEMANTIC_SEARCH` | bool | `on` | restart | When on (default), the email tools search by meaning as well as by words, the index follows new mail, and a heartbeat fills in older mail in small batches; 0 turns it off. |
    | `IRIS_FOLLOWUP_ACTIONABLE_ROOTS` | list |  | next call | Comma-separated email category roots that may create follow-up tasks; unset uses personal, work, finance, jobs, travel, community. |
